items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT or DOUBTFUL for Sunday with hamstring; ruled out by team/Schefter after missing practice. Week 1 ran 37/42 routes.
items.why: Hamstring tweak in Wednesday practice; history of multi-game hamstring absences; Friday DNP and official out.
items.implication: Texans WR room thinned; volume to Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel and TE Schultz.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining HOU pass-catchers.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed doubtful for Sunday vs Saints (hamstring); missed practices early week.
items.why: Hamstring; limited/no practice Wed-Thu; official doubtful tag.
items.implication: BAL WR hierarchy shifts if out; Ja'Kobi Lane also out/IR.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/targets for Bateman and other Ravens WRs/TE Andrews.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers doubtful vs Chargers (knee); per HC after limited/no full practice early week.
items.why: Recovering meniscus; Friday practice but doubtful designation.
items.implication: Michael Mayer likely primary TE target if Bowers sits (led targets W1).
items.opportunity: Mayer route/target share expansion; TE streaming.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN and ready for 2026 debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown on IR. Unclear full share vs Stevenson but possible 10+ touches; strong upcoming schedule.
items.why: Ready statement + AJ Brown IR + NE need explosives; nice matchups ahead (PIT/JAX etc before bye).
items.implication: Handcuff/flex upside; monitor snap share vs Stevenson.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes expansion in pass-heavy or explosive role.

items.text: Joe Burrow QUESTIONABLE (back) but said he's playing; listed Q by Bengals.
items.why: Back injury; self-reported playing intent; official Q tag.
items.implication: Start with confidence if active; monitor for any setback.
items.opportunity: Full CIN passing volume if cleared.

items.text: AJ Brown OUT (ankle, IR/return context); Alvin Kamara IN; TreVeyon Henderson IN; multiple other OUTs including Penix/Murray/Darnold/Tua/Okonkwo.
items.why: Official ETR Sunday injury roundup from reports.
items.implication: NE WR crumbs; NO backfield Kamara return squeezes Etienne; Henderson opportunity.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey questionable (ribs) for Sunday vs Raiders; practiced Friday after earlier DNPs.
items.why: Rib injury from W1 exit; Friday practice upgrade to Q.
items.implication: Biggest slate injury per Levitan; impacts Herbert projections and LAC WR hierarchy (Johnston upside). Game 4pm ET.
items.opportunity: If out, volume to Quentin Johnston and other Chargers receivers.

items.text: If Zay Flowers out (hamstring), Ravens WR order: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore. Lane already IR/return (wrist).
items.why: Flowers multi-day DNP; Lane fractured wrist IR.
items.implication: BAL down to crumbs at WR; target Bateman/Andrews higher.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 24% target share (tied team lead) W1, 21/24 RB touches thru 3Q, 74% snaps; Indy just gave up big to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes if healthy.
items.why: Elite W1 utilization + soft run matchup.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 in W1 (tied Bijan lead); high target share recent; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.why: Near-max utilization under Kubiak; workhorse role confirmed.
items.implication: RB1 play; overreaction to any prior injury scare.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: Career-high 26% target share W1, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB RZ touches; CLE soft vs run.
LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz W1; career 93 yds/18 PPG with Wentz; CHI secondary soft.
LOVE DeVonta Smith @ TEN: 27% target share + 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) W1; TEN soft vs WR (high catch rate/YPR allowed).
items.why: Rebound volume + favorable matchup after tough W1.

items.text: HATE Marvin Harrison Jr (8% tgt share W1, 0 RZ, tough SEA), Brian Thomas Jr (@DEN tough perimeter/deep, limited practice shoulder), Harold Fannin (low 14% tgt/3.3 aDOT, low implied total).
items.why: Poor W1 usage + tough matchups/injury concerns.
